annotations.title: BTC/ETH options market state with history context

description: Current dealer gamma regime (positive = hedging dampens moves, negative = amplifies), zero-gamma flip, call/put walls, DVOL and its 1-year rank, implied-minus-realized volatility, IV term structure and the INDICIA Fear & Greed index, with how long the regime has lasted in our daily archive. Descriptive context, not a direction call. Data refreshes about every 2 hours; the result carries as_of.
name: market_state

as_of.description: UTC time the underlying data was computed.

stale.description: True when the data is older than its normal refresh cycle.
